data.title: Golf Acres
data.about:
Prepare for the latest addition to the thriving Emaar South community with Golf Acres, offering 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses with generously sized units. Overlooking the golf course, this upcoming project by Emaar is designed for modern living with contemporary interiors, ample natural light, and thoughtful layouts. This development is located in one of Dubai’s most strategic areas, combining serene green spaces with seamless connectivity to major landmarks, making it the perfect choice for families, professionals, and investors alike.

What makes this launch even more attractive is its highly reasonable pricing, considering the prime location and spacious designs. This is an unmissable opportunity to own a luxurious home or a high-potential investment in the heart of Emaar South. With eco-friendly community parks, retail plazas, and healthcare and education facilities nearby, Golf Acres offers an exceptional environment for families and individuals alike, setting a new standard for modern living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Secure Your Future - Invest in Golf Acres at Emaar South!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Golf-Inspired Lifestyle: Access to a championship 18-hole golf course, a state-of-the-art clubhouse, and breathtaking fairway views, perfect for golf enthusiasts.
  • Prime Location: Strategically located on Dubai–Al Ain Road with seamless connectivity to key destinations such as Al Maktoum International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai Marina.
  • Luxury Residences: A choice of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses featuring contemporary designs, earthy tones, and nature-inspired architecture.
  • World-Class Amenities: Offers outdoor gyms, yoga decks, swimming pools, jogging tracks, BBQ areas, kids’ play areas, and retail plazas for a balanced lifestyle.
  • Eco-Friendly Community: Includes green spaces, community parks, and a serene environment designed for wellness and relaxation.
  • Developer Reputation: Developed by Emaar, one of the world’s leading real estate developers known for quality and trust.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: Features educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and recreational options within close proximity, catering to families and individuals alike.

location_tile.title: Emaar South: The Perfect Blend of Lifestyle and Growth
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Emaar South is a thriving, master-planned community that offers a balanced lifestyle of modern convenience and natural serenity, making it an excellent choice for property investment. The community boasts a wide range of amenities, including hotels, golf courses, clubhouses, retail outlets, clinics, parks, and schools, ensuring everything you need is right at your doorstep.

With its proximity to major highways and key landmarks like Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport, Emaar South enjoys unparalleled connectivity. Established projects such as Urbana townhouses, Golf Links standalone villas, and Golf Views apartments have already been successfully handed over, further solidifying the area’s reputation as a high-demand residential destination.

  • Al Maktoum International Airport – 10 minutes
  • City Dubai – 15 minutes
  • Dubai Parks and Resorts – 20 minutes
  • Jebel Ali Port – 25 minutes
  • Dubai Marina – 30 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai – 40 minutes

seo.metaDescription: Don’t miss the exciting opportunity! Discover Golf Acres in Emaar South. 1 to 3-bedroom apartments offering golf course views. Book now!

more_info.answer:
The available unit sizes and starting prices at Golf Acres, Emaar South, are as follows:

1-Bedroom Apartments: Sizes start from 738 sq. ft. to 827 sq. ft., priced from AED 0.95 million.
2-Bedroom Apartments: Sizes range from 1,220 sq. ft. to 1,731 sq. ft., priced from AED 1.75 million.
3-Bedroom Apartments: Sizes range from 1,804 sq. ft. to 2,255 sq. ft., priced from AED 2.49 million.
3-Bedroom Townhouses: Sizes start from 2,563 sq. ft., priced from AED 4.04 million.
